goals.ps_2d_whale_world-v1: Get every whale (brown block) off the level by moving it onto the orange void outside the walls, which removes it. Whales move when the player crosses their yellow beam lines, and the level is won when no whale remains.
goals.ps_always_magnets-v1: Move the player (magnet) into the green target tile; stepping onto the target triggers the win rule and completes the level.
goals.ps_fused_copy-v1: Remove every pink block and every blue block from the level by pushing blocks of different colours into each other so that they destroy each other.
goals.ps_baba_is_you-v1: Get an object that IS YOU onto an object that IS WIN, or make one object both YOU and WIN. In level 1 the rules are BABA IS YOU and FLAG IS WIN, so Baba must reach the flag.
goals.ps_enqueue-v1: Remove every pad by moving a block of the same colour onto each coloured plus-shaped pad, sending the blocks through the queue in the order the pads need.
goals.ps_explod-v1: Get the living player (pink figure) onto the Goal tile (the black/dark-blue door), usually by lighting and pushing bombs to blow up the walls in the way.
goals.ps_barrier_trail-v1: Touch the white target squares to activate them (which turns the orange plus tiles into barrier crates), then push a barrier crate onto every activated target.
goals.ps_castlemouse-v1: Slide every mouse into a hole so that no mouse is left on the board. In level 1 the player is the single mouse M and must slide into the black hole H.
goals.ps_count_mover-v1: Push every brown crate onto a red/yellow goal tile. Ending4 follows automatically once all goals are covered, and efficiency only changes the closing message.
goals.ps_fish_friend-v1: Get both the human (Hugh) and the fish (Fitch) to the far right edge of the level, each directly left of the black right border. Text levels are won by pressing action once all the text is shown.
goals.ps_alternatey-v1: Get the white player squares and the orange goal dots to match exactly, so every player is on a goal and every goal has a player on it. Each move flips which empty cells hold players.
goals.ps_extra_step-v1: Collect (eat) every blue pellet, which turns the target square into a burner, then finish with the player standing on that target and no extra-step move still in progress.
goals.ps_bruised-v1: Push the yellow/orange cube crates so that every target square has a crate on it (Sokoban-style).
goals.ps_coin_counter-v1: Collect every coin (yellow ring) and fiver so none remain, then have the player stand on the invisible ending tile at the end of the corridor.
goals.ps_copy_pellets-v1: Eat every yellow pellet (eating one clones the green crates) and leave a green crate on every green X target (and an orange crate on every orange target).
goals.ps_fire_in_winter-v1: Push every crate into the fire (furnace), which burns it to ash; the level is won when no crate is left.
goals.ps_icecrates-v1: Slide the player (red sliding figure) so it comes to rest on the green goal flag.
goals.ps_life_is_hard-v1: Kill every yellow cell in this Game-of-Life-style board, so that no cell is left.
goals.ps_knightoban-v1: Cover every target (dark blue square) with a crate (red square); here crates move by knight-style jumps rather than plain pushes.
goals.ps_multi_word_dictionary_game-v1: Push or pull the letter blocks so they sit side by side in a row, reading left to right as CAT or ACT. That marks them Won and wins the level.
goals.ps_liquid_war_alpha-v1: There is no goal: the game has no win condition and no win rule, so the level can never be finished. It is a real-time sandbox where red slime follows the green player, blue slime follows the red enemy, and the two slimes convert each other.
goals.ps_moving_target-v1: Move so that every target (the white diamond marker, which shifts along with the player's moves) ends up on top of a crate (the yellow block).
goals.ps_jam3_game-v1: Make a single match that pops same-coloured gems on every cyan target cell at once, so the whole highlighted strip clears in one go with one colour.
goals.ps_hue_change-v1: Formally the player must stand on a Target, but level 1 has no Target, so it can never be won. The game's own stated goal is to keep stepping onto the black-dot spawner squares where the blue and yellow blocks sit, pushing each block off first, to raise the score as high as possible.
goals.ps_mc_escher_s_equestrian_armageddon-v1: Kill every horse: stand next to each horse and press action to turn it into blood, until no horse is left.
goals.ps_paralands-v1: Get the player (orange figure) onto the gray/lightgray goal tile ('!'), which in level 1 sits in the centre behind four omni doors.
goals.ps_push-v1: Reach and grab the golden idol by moving the player into it (you can push only one rock), so no idol is left.
goals.ps_pretender_to_the_crown-v1: Free every prisoner by pushing the guard (enemy) beside it, which removes the prisoner, then move the crowned player onto the red exit arrow.
goals.ps_midas-v1: Bring the player next to the black lady figure (Target) so love appears, after washing off the gold crown in water so she is not turned to gold.
goals.ps_singleton_traffic-v1: Move the player tiles (all of which move together) until they are locked in place so that no tile can move at all; the level is won when nothing can move.
goals.ps_roll_those_sixes-v1: Push dice into each other so they merge (pips add up) until no dice showing 1 to 5 remain, so every die is a six.
goals.ps_sok7-v1: Clear every disc (the numbered 1-7 tiles and any garbage discs) off the board. You do this by pushing them so that a disc numbered N sits in an unbroken line of exactly N discs, which makes it disappear.
goals.ps_stairways-v1: Move the player onto the stairs, which start hidden under a block, by pushing boxes, which move together in rows or columns, out of the way.
goals.ps_skipping_stones-v1: Get off the islands by boarding a seaworthy ship: repair your damaged ship with wood from a palm tree, or find the strange unguarded ship, then sail away. Collecting treasure is optional.
goals.ps_sokoban_basic-v1: Push the orange crates so that every dark-blue target square has a crate on it.
goals.ps_sliding_ground-v1: Get the purple crate onto every target (white diamond marker) by pushing it and sliding the movable floor tiles over the pits; every target must have a crate on it.
goals.ps_stairs-v1: Move the light-blue player onto the white cross Goal tile (in the centre, sitting on a stair) to finish the level.
goals.ps_sokofun_clone-v1: Push the coloured blocks so that all blocks of the same colour form one connected touching group. Levels with crates also need every target covered by a crate, and the player must not end up in a laser ray.
goals.ps_stand_off-v1: Get the player (brown cowboy) to the exit gap (X) in the border wall without being shot by the red bad guys.
goals.ps_teleporters-v1: Push teleport blocks (purple or green teleblocks) so that every pale-yellow X target has a block on it; in level 1 that is one block on the single central target.
goals.ps_test_gist_script-v1: Push the orange crate onto the dark blue target so that every target has a crate on it.
goals.ps_tidy_the_cafe-v1: Push every chair so it is tucked in against a table, facing it, and make every table fully surrounded on all four sides by tucked-in chairs or obstacles.
goals.ps_the_walls_you_leave_behind-v1: Push the purple crates so that every target (yellow cross tile) has a crate on it.
goals.ps_sleepy_players-v1: Use the three brown players, which move together, to push the single teal/brown crate (legend '@', text id 4) onto the blue/green bed target ('t', id 3).
goals.ps_the_big_dig-v1: Dig into the brown dig-walls to turn them into gold crates, then push gold crates so every yellow-outlined target has a crate on it.
goals.ps_unclean_residues-v1: Push crates (orange stones, including the green-marked contaminated ones) so that every pink target marker is covered by a crate.
goals.ps_using_pushers-v1: Get the orange crate onto every target tile (the cream patterned tile). The player cannot push the crate directly and has to move it with the blue pusher blocks.
goals.ps_vines-v1: Get the player out of the factory by climbing (ladders and light-grown vines) to the invisible target cells just above the factory roof at the top of the level.
goals.ps_bomb_n_ice-v1: Push the light-blue sliding ice blocks so that every X-shaped target tile has an ice block on it.
goals.ps_train_braining-v1: Lay rail track from the starting track end, around the forest obstacles, to the exit rail at the top edge, so the train and its cart drive off the map. In later levels, every passenger must also be dropped at a station of their colour.
